C0514.title: HTTPS Interception Weakens TLS Security
C0514.summary: CISA issued an alert warning that HTTPS inspection products work by intercepting HTTPS traffic and performing man-in-the-middle attacks. During this process, sensitive client data may be transmitted to malicious parties posing as the target server.
